# NEW 2026-11-20 Yuan portraits (group yuan-portraits1). Generated by tools_20261117/gen_yuan_portraits.py; edit the
# generator, not this file. Models and textures: Bamboo King's Community Flavor Pack (Workshop 3763953914), used with
# the maker's permission; see third_party/bamboo_king/MANIFEST.md.
# Character scope (portrait modifiers). Who wears the Yuan robes; see the docstring of the generator for the ranks.

# Country scope. A branch secretariat of the Yuan that is still one.
oe_yp_portrait_branch = {
    country_exists = c:CHI
    is_subject_of = c:CHI
    OR = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_yp_ended }
}
# The common conditions: an adult man, not clergy, not in armour, and the Yuan stands.
oe_yp_portrait_base = {
    exists = this
    is_adult = yes
    is_female = no
    is_religious_figure = no
    NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate }
    portrait_wear_armor_trigger = no
    oe_yp_yuan_fallen = no
}
# A Mongol: graphical culture mongol_gfx or a culture of the vanilla Mongolian group.
oe_yp_portrait_mongol = {
    OR = {
        portrait_clothing_trigger = { CULTURE_FLAG = mongol_gfx }
        culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group }
    }
}
oe_yp_portrait_emperor = {
    oe_yp_portrait_base = yes
    portrait_is_ruler_of_trigger = { COUNTRY = CHI }
}
oe_yp_portrait_prince = {
    oe_yp_portrait_base = yes
    NOT = { portrait_is_ruler_of_trigger = { COUNTRY = CHI } }
    OR = {
        AND = {
            is_ruler = yes
            any_ruling_countries = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            is_ruler = no
            employer ?= { tag = CHI }
            OR = {
                is_heir = yes
                AND = {
                    c:CHI = { exists = ruler }
                    is_close_relative = c:CHI.ruler
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
oe_yp_portrait_high = {
    oe_yp_portrait_base = yes
    NOT = { oe_yp_portrait_emperor = yes }
    NOT = { oe_yp_portrait_prince = yes }
    OR = {
        AND = {
            employer ?= { tag = CHI }
            in_cabinet = yes
        }
        AND = {
            is_ruler = yes
            any_ruling_countries = { oe_yp_portrait_branch = yes }
        }
    }
}
oe_yp_portrait_low = {
    oe_yp_portrait_base = yes
    is_ruler = no
    NOT = { oe_yp_portrait_prince = yes }
    NOT = { oe_yp_portrait_high = yes }
    employer ?= {
        OR = {
            tag = CHI
            oe_yp_portrait_branch = yes
        }
    }
}
# Any rank (the hats follow the culture, the robes the rank).
oe_yp_portrait_any = {
    OR = {
        oe_yp_portrait_emperor = yes
        oe_yp_portrait_prince = yes
        oe_yp_portrait_high = yes
        oe_yp_portrait_low = yes
    }
}

# One trigger per portrait-modifier item. Each item, its trigger and its gene template carry the same name (vanilla also
# names an item after its template, e.g. chinese_imperial).
oe_yp_portrait_robe_mongol = {
    oe_yp_portrait_emperor = yes
    oe_yp_portrait_mongol = yes
}
oe_yp_portrait_robe_imperial = {
    oe_yp_portrait_emperor = yes
    oe_yp_portrait_mongol = no
}

    oe_yp_portrait_prince = yes
}

    oe_yp_portrait_high = yes
}
oe_yp_portrait_robe_low = {
    oe_yp_portrait_low = yes
}

    oe_yp_portrait_any = yes
    oe_yp_portrait_mongol = yes
}

    oe_yp_portrait_mongol = no
    OR = {
        oe_yp_portrait_emperor = yes
        oe_yp_portrait_prince = yes
        oe_yp_portrait_high = yes
    }
}
